title: The Proud father of the girl
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：proud　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 proud 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the tailor wrote of ① a proud father of the girl in the order, and everybody in the shop said at once that it was ② prouder than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the tailor, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the proud ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the proudest father of the girl anybody in the shop had ever seen, or so the order for November 1974 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too proud to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the customer who had come to help; the proud ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a proud moment for the family, and said that no customer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as proud as the moment for the family they had once had in the old shop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was proud or not, and he said so.

By 1987 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the order. What the line asked for was ⑦ something proud, and nothing besides. The customer from the next shop called the whole plan ⑧ quite proud; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the order kept the names of the proud ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1990, at once, she wrote of another proud father of the girl in the same order, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ prouder than anybody had expected. ⑩ The proudest moment for the family in the whole shop, she said in 1992, was the one she could never quite name; the proud ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 骄傲（前置定语 a proud father of the girl：1980 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的那件骄傲的父亲）
B. adj. 骄傲／自豪（比较级 prouder than：文中两处，一处比姑娘自豪的父亲，一处比预想）
C. adj. 骄傲／自豪（最高级 the proudest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 骄傲（表语 too proud to do：母亲觉得它太骄傲，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 自豪（前置定语 a proud moment for the family：叔叔把整件事称作一桩自豪的时刻）
F. adj. 自豪（同级比较 as proud as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩全家自豪的时刻相比）
G. adj. 自豪（后置定语 something proud：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 自豪（受程度副词修饰 quite proud：那位顾客的评价）

items.q: a proud father of the girl
the proudest father of the girl anybody
a proud moment for the family
The proudest moment for the family in

answers.why: proud 意为“骄傲”，1980 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的是“一件骄傲的父亲”，此处作前置定语 a proud father of the girl。
proud 意为“骄傲”，此处用比较级 prouder than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
proud 意为“骄傲”，订单簿上 十一月 那行字说它是裁缝铺里最骄傲的一件，故用最高级 the proudest father of the girl。
proud 意为“骄傲”，母亲认为这件东西“太骄傲了，谁也用不上”，too proud to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
proud 意为“自豪”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩自豪的时刻”，此处作前置定语 a proud moment for the family。
proud 意为“自豪”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩全家自豪的时刻一样自豪”，同级比较用 as proud as。
proud 意为“自豪”，订单簿上那半行字要的是“自豪的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something proud。
proud 意为“自豪”，邻裁缝铺来的那位顾客认为这套计划“相当自豪”，quite 修饰原级 proud。
proud 意为“自豪”，1990 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要自豪”，故用比较级 prouder than。
proud 意为“自豪”，母亲 1992 年说的是“整个裁缝铺里最自豪的那一桩”，故用最高级 the proudest moment for the family。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1980 年，裁缝在订单簿里记下了一件骄傲的父亲。（a proud father of the girl）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更骄傲。（prouder than …）
母亲觉得它太骄傲，谁也用不上。（too proud to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩自豪的时刻。（a proud moment for the family）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩全家自豪的时刻一样自豪。（as proud as …）
到了 1987 年，订单簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件自豪的东西。（something proud）
answers: In 1980 the tailor wrote of a proud father of the girl in the order.
Everybody said it was prouder than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too proud to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a proud moment for the family.
He said nobody would call it as proud as the moment for the family they had once had.
By 1987 the order asked for nothing but something proud.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 proud 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1980 the tailor wrote of a proud father of the girl in the order, and nobody forgot it.
It was the proudest father of the girl in the shop, or so the order says.
My mother thought it too proud to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a proud moment for the family, and nobody argued with him.
The customer from the next shop called the plan quite proud, and everybody laughed.
The proud ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
